# Fraud Analysis and Risk Management Review

This document details key action items for the Risk & Compliance department, focusing on maintaining robust internal controls and mitigating various risks.

## Action Items:

*   Review the internal control based on audit findings.
*   Optimize legal risks based on audit recommendations.
*   Investigate regulatory changes quarterly.
*   Investigate AML (Anti-Money Laundering) detection urgently.
*   Monitor the internal control based on audit findings.
